title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat in the Queues app Recap tab for recorded call queue calls
summary: Hold: the recording command enables recording but leaves transcription disabled and does not set the representative-access control advertised by its row. The briefing also treats the Copilot licence requirement as unresolved and budgets only for Teams Phone and Teams Premium, although Microsoft's general requirements identify the Copilot licence for this class of capability.

claims.claim: New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate -RecordingEnabled $true is the automation equivalent for the row's recording, transcription and representative-access controls.
claims.quote: -TranscriptionEnabled: Is transcription enabled. Type: Boolean. Default value: False. -AgentViewPermission: Are agents allowed to access the recordings or transcriptions. Supported values: None | All. Default value: None.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api.call with 'New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate -RecordingEnabled $true -TranscriptionEnabled $true -AgentViewPermission <None or All>'. This supplies the deciding parameters for all three controls described by the row; the remaining template-creation parameters can stay in the reference. Keep the current docs URL.
